title.zh: Claude Code开始拆自己：Function Hooks正式上线为Mods
title.en: Claude Code开始拆自己：Function Hooks正式上线为Mods

current_state.zh: Anthropic officially launched Claude Code Mods, the Function Hooks-based plugin system that lets users rewrite prompts, intercept tool calls and permissions, and replace UI components — while noting Mods run without sandboxing and carry the same local privileges as Claude Code itself.
current_state.en: Anthropic officially launched Claude Code Mods, the Function Hooks-based plugin system that lets users rewrite prompts, intercept tool calls and permissions, and replace UI components — while noting Mods run without sandboxing and carry the same local privileges as Claude Code itself.
